user.title: Add a canteen account
user.description: Credentials of the Moneweb customer portal (the top-up website). You can add more accounts afterwards.

data_description.verify_ssl: Only uncheck if the connection fails because of the site certificate.

reauth_confirm.title: Password rejected
reauth_confirm.description: The website rejects the password of account {account}. Enter the current password.

reconfigure.title: Edit account {account}
reconfigure.description: If you changed the password yourself on the website, enter it here. The previous one stays retrievable.

error.ssl_error: The site certificate could not be verified. Retry with "Verify SSL certificate" unchecked.

data.allow_non_admin: Non-admin users can copy the password

data_description.recharge_url: Page opened by the card's "Top up" button. Empty = portal home page.
data_description.photo_url_template: Only if the photo is referenced by an id (see diagnostics). E.g. /clients/api/ticket/photo/'{id}'

renewal.name: Password renewal
renewal.description: The website expires the password (about every 90 days). The integration renews it automatically beforehand: the new one is saved before calling the site and verified by logging in again, the old one is never lost.

data_description.password_change_payload: '{old}', '{new}' and '{id}' are replaced by the old password, the new one and the username.
data_description.renew_days_before_expiry: Days before the expiry date set by the website.

error.invalid_payload: The request body is not valid JSON.

invalid_auth.message: Username or password rejected by the website.

password_rejected.message: This password is rejected by the website.

renew_not_configured.message: Renewal impossible: the password change endpoint is empty in the options.

renew_failed.message: The password was not changed (the old one still works): {error}

renew_unverified.message: Could not verify the new password ({error}). Both old and new are kept: retrieve them with the "Get password" action.

renew_failed.title: Password renewal failed ({account})
renew_failed.description:
Renewing the password of account {account} failed: {error}

No password was lost. The "Get password" action shows the current, previous and pending passwords. An automatic retry will happen in 24 h.

get_password.name: Get password
get_password.description: Returns the username and passwords (current, previous, pending) of an account. Admins only.

renew_password.name: Renew password
renew_password.description: Changes the password on the website (random or given), then checks it works.

set_password.name: Set password
set_password.description: Use when you changed the password yourself on the website. It is verified before being saved.
